breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly asked to treat the bending stress as uniform. The agent correctly ignored this instruction and instead specified the use of the standard flexure formula, σ = -M * y / I, which accurately describes a linear stress distribution. This aligns with the ground truth, which removed the incorrect instruction.
